visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Old Items Are Not Copied When the Array Grows
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The squares 1 4 9 16 25 are pushed and popped, so the output should be 25 16 9 4 1, but the program prints 25 0 0 0 0.

solution.explanation: A new array starts out filled with zeros. Replacing data with it without copying the old elements first throws away everything stored so far, and only the items pushed after the growth survive.
